title: 12 Best Microsoft Teams Ticketing Tools for MSPs
summary: Compare 12 of the best Microsoft Teams ticketing tools for MSPs, including key features, integrations, and options for managing client support.
body_markdown:
Managed service providers (MSPs) handle client support across multiple organizations, each with distinct SLA requirements, security expectations, and communication preferences. As more clients use Microsoft Teams for daily collaboration, MSPs need ticketing solutions that support requests directly within these existing workflows.


The challenge goes beyond connecting tickets to Teams. MSPs need multi-tenant architecture for client isolation, per-customer SLAs, RMM integration, billing automation, and AI capabilities that reduce manual triage.


A[Microsoft Teams ticketing solution](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support/?ref=unthread.io) built for MSP workflows helps technicians respond faster while maintaining the operational structure that service delivery demands.


## **Key Takeaways**


- MSPs should prioritize ticketing tools that support multi-tenant client isolation, per-customer SLAs, RMM integration, and billing automation.
- [Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) is the recommended option for MSPs managing clients across multiple platforms (Teams, Slack, and email) who want AI-driven automation and a unified inbox.
- Teams-native and multi-channel ticketing platforms serve different MSP needs, depending on whether clients primarily use[Microsoft Teams](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support/?ref=unthread.io) or rely on a mix of collaboration tools, email, and portals.
- Unthread combines ticketing,[workflow automation](https://unthread.io/products/automations/?ref=unthread.io) , and[knowledge management](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base/?ref=unthread.io) , helping MSPs streamline recurring requests and SLA tracking across client communication channels.


## **What MSPs Should Look for in a Microsoft Teams Ticketing Tool**


MSP ticketing has different requirements than internal IT or customer support. A client infrastructure request, security incident, or onboarding task needs proper client isolation, technician assignment, SLA tracking, and often integration with RMM and billing systems.


A strong Microsoft Teams ticketing tool for MSPs should help teams:


- Convert Teams messages, emails, and portal requests into tracked tickets
- Route requests by client, urgency, technician expertise, or SLA tier
- Maintain strict per-client data isolation
- Automate recurring Tier 1 requests and common troubleshooting
- Build a reusable[knowledge base](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base/?ref=unthread.io) from resolved client issues
- Track SLAs and technician workload across client accounts
- Connect with RMM, PSA, HRIS, and CRM tools through[integration capabilities](https://unthread.io/products/integrations/?ref=unthread.io)


The most practical systems let MSPs keep client communication natural while adding operational structure behind the scenes.


## **1) Unthread: Multi-Channel AI Help Desk for MSPs**


[Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) turns Microsoft Teams, Slack, email, and client portals into a unified[IT service desk](https://unthread.io/solutions/it-service-desk/?ref=unthread.io) for MSPs managing diverse client environments. It is built for service providers who need multi-channel intake, AI automation, and structured ticketing without forcing clients into separate portals.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


Unthread is designed for MSPs whose clients use different collaboration platforms. Some clients may standardize on Teams, others on Slack, and many still rely on email.


Rather than managing separate ticketing systems for each channel, Unthread consolidates everything into a single inbox with consistent routing, SLA tracking, and[analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics/?ref=unthread.io) .


A client channel such as a shared Teams space can become a full service desk. General questions can stay in-channel when appropriate, while sensitive matters can move into private workflows for security.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- [Purpose-built AI agents](https://unthread.io/products/agentic-ai/?ref=unthread.io) for triage, routing, and automatic resolution
- Multi-channel unified inbox across Teams, Slack, and email
- [Workflow automations](https://unthread.io/products/automations/?ref=unthread.io) for recurring requests, escalations, and technician handoffs
- Self-learning[knowledge management](https://unthread.io/products/knowledge-base/?ref=unthread.io) that turns resolved tickets into reusable documentation
- [AI analytics](https://unthread.io/products/analytics/?ref=unthread.io) for identifying request trends, SLA risks, and automation opportunities
- [SOC 2 Type II compliance](https://unthread.io/security/?ref=unthread.io) with HIPAA support for regulated clients


The platform supports approximately[40% automatic ticket resolution](https://unthread.io/blog/it-ticketing-software-msps/) in production deployments across IT, HR, and operational support functions. This includes a broader range of Tier 1 workflows beyond simple access requests.


### **What MSPs Should Consider**


Unthread is the clearest fit when clients use multiple collaboration platforms and MSPs want to reduce manual triage without adding complexity.


Teams can evaluate the platform through a[14-day free trial](https://unthread.io/pricing/?ref=unthread.io) , with plans starting at $75 per agent/month.


## **2) Desk365**


Desk365 is a Microsoft Teams-native help desk designed for organizations standardized on Microsoft 365. It offers multi-channel intake through Teams, email, and web portals with a free tier.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


Desk365 provides Microsoft Teams-based ticketing for SMB-focused MSPs operating within Microsoft 365 environments. It supports Microsoft Entra ID integration for identity management and user authentication.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Native Microsoft Teams ticketing with email and portal intake
- Microsoft Entra SSO and Microsoft 365 Copilot integration
- AI-assisted knowledge base article generation
- GDPR and HIPAA compliance


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should check how Desk365 handles multi-tenant client isolation and whether the platform supports the RMM integrations and billing workflows that larger service providers require.


## **3) TeamsWork (Ticketing as a Service)**


TeamsWork provides ticketing functionality within Microsoft Teams, allowing users to create, update, and manage tickets through the platform. It follows a usage-based pricing model rather than per-agent fees.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


TeamsWork offers Microsoft Teams-based ticketing for MSPs and internal IT teams. Technicians and clients can create, update, and resolve tickets directly within Teams.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Tickets stay entirely in Teams channels and chats
- Multi-instance support for MSPs managing multiple clients
- Microsoft 365 Certified (SOC 2, GDPR)
- Regional data hosting options (US HIPAA, EU GDPR, APAC)


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should evaluate whether purely Teams-native ticketing meets their needs or if multi-channel intake (email, Slack, portals) is required for diverse client environments.


## **4) DeskDay (IT-Connect)**


DeskDay provides a PSA platform with native Microsoft Teams ticketing designed for MSPs serving external clients.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


DeskDay focuses on ticketing for managed service providers serving external clients. Its IT-Connect app enables users to create tickets through Microsoft Teams, with real-time chat synchronized with the PSA platform.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Teams-to-PSA multichannel ticketing
- Helena AI assistant for ticket responses
- End-user SSO ticket creation
- Real-time chat synchronization between Teams and PSA


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should compare DeskDay's full PSA capabilities against their actual requirements for billing, contracts, and project management.


## **5) ConnectWise PSA**


ConnectWise PSA is an enterprise PSA platform that supports ticketing, contract management, billing, and integrations for MSP operations.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


ConnectWise is designed for MSPs managing multi-location operations, contracts, and service delivery processes. Its PSA platform includes billing, time tracking, and project management alongside ticketing.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Service boards, time tracking, and contract billing
- ConnectWise Sidekick AI for ticket triage and PowerShell scripting
- Native integration with ConnectWise RMM and Automate
- Support for multi-location MSP operations


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should assess ConnectWise's implementation timeline, administrative requirements, and day-to-day configuration processes against their operational needs.


## **6) HaloPSA**


HaloPSA is a PSA platform with a single-tier pricing structure that includes its available features without separate enterprise-tier upgrades.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


HaloPSA’s platform includes a single-tier pricing structure, PSA functionality, and an interface for managing service operations.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Single-tier pricing with all features included
- Native integrations including RMM platforms
- User interface for managing PSA workflows
- PSA functionality including billing, contracts, and projects


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should compare HaloPSA's integration depth with their existing RMM and verify that the Microsoft Teams connection meets their client communication requirements.


## **7) Autotask PSA (Datto)**


Autotask PSA provides enterprise PSA capabilities integrated with the Datto/Kaseya ecosystem for MSPs standardized on those tools.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


Autotask integrates with Datto RMM and IT Glue for MSP service management workflows. Its Datto RMM integration supports automatic ticket creation from RMM alerts, including associated device information.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- AI-powered smart ticket tagging and knowledge base suggestions
- Ticket-to-invoice workflows tied to contracts and services
- Audit trail depth for HIPAA-regulated clients
- Enterprise security (256-bit encryption, 2FA)


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs outside the Kaseya ecosystem should evaluate whether the integration benefits justify the cost compared to more platform-agnostic alternatives.


## **8) SuperOps**


SuperOps combines PSA, RMM, and AI-powered automation within a single platform. Its functionality covers ticket management and technician operations, with options for unified or standalone PSA modules.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


SuperOps is designed for MSP operations, with PSA and RMM capabilities covering ticket management, remote monitoring, and workflow automation. Its pricing follows a per-technician model.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Monica AI for ticket classification and workflow automation
- Unified PSA and RMM in a single interface
- Published per-technician pricing
- Remote monitoring and endpoint management


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should assess SuperOps' scalability and Microsoft Teams integration against their operational and day-to-day requirements.


## **9) Syncro**


Syncro provides unified RMM, PSA, and ticketing with per-technician pricing and unlimited endpoints.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


Syncro focuses on MSP service management workflows, including remote monitoring, ticket handling, and invoicing. Its database connects these functions, allowing technicians to manage operational tasks within the same system.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Per-technician pricing
- Smart Ticket Management AI
- Built-in billing and invoicing in the same database
- Unified database connecting RMM and PSA


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should evaluate whether the unified approach provides enough depth in each area (RMM, PSA, ticketing) compared to best-of-breed alternatives.


## **10) Tikit (Cireson)**


Tikit provides Teams-native ticketing with Microsoft 365 ecosystem integration, including Entra ID and Intune.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


Tikit focuses on ticket management within Microsoft 365 environments. Its integrations with Entra ID, Intune, and Power BI connect ticketing processes with identity management, device administration, and reporting.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Native Entra ID and Intune integration
- Azure OpenAI-powered virtual agent
- Power Automate and Power BI connections
- Pricing from $26/agent/month (billed annually)


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should check whether Tikit requires external portals for certain workflows and whether its MSP-specific features (multi-tenancy, per-client SLAs) meet service provider requirements.


## **11) Freshservice**


Freshservice provides ITIL-aligned IT service management for MSPs whose clients require formal service management processes.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


Freshservice incorporates structured IT service management processes, including incident tracking and service request handling. Its ITIL-aligned workflows support documentation and service management across different IT environments.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- ITIL-aligned incident, problem, change, and release management
- Freddy AI Copilot for ticket summarization (paid add-on)
- Change Advisory Board and change calendars
- Knowledge base with role-based access


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should evaluate whether ITIL-heavy processes match their client needs and how well Freshservice handles Teams-native request intake versus external portals.


## **12) Zendesk**


Zendesk is an omnichannel customer support platform that manages communication across email, chat, voice, and messaging.


### **Why It Fits MSPs**


Zendesk supports client communication across multiple channels. Its service management capabilities include ticket routing, automated responses, and reporting for tracking support requests and agent activity.


### **MSP-Relevant Capabilities**


- Omnichannel ticketing (email, chat, voice, messaging)
- AI-powered automated resolutions (per-resolution billing)
- Enterprise platform with global support
- Pricing from $19-115/agent/month


### **What MSPs Should Review**


MSPs should evaluate whether Zendesk's customer support orientation translates to MSP-specific needs like multi-tenancy, per-client SLAs, and RMM integration.

[Unthread](https://unthread.io/?ref=unthread.io) fits that need because it combines[Microsoft Teams support](https://unthread.io/products/microsoft-teams-support/?ref=unthread.io) with Slack, email, and portal intake in a unified platform. ## **Frequently Asked Questions**


### **What makes a Microsoft Teams ticketing tool useful for MSPs?**


A Teams ticketing tool helps MSPs convert client messages into structured requests with ownership, SLA tracking, and client isolation. This matters because MSPs manage multiple client environments with different service levels and security requirements.


Unthread gives MSPs a way to keep client communication conversational while managing work through a[structured service desk](https://unthread.io/products/slack-support?ref=unthread.io) .


### **How can MSPs handle multi-tenant client isolation in Teams?**


MSPs should use a platform that maintains strict per-client data separation and supports client-specific SLAs. This is important for security, compliance, and billing accuracy.


Unthread supports multi-channel intake with proper client isolation so MSPs can manage diverse portfolios from a[unified inbox](https://unthread.io/products/shared-email-inbox?ref=unthread.io) .


### **Can AI help resolve routine MSP tickets automatically?**


Yes. AI can help resolve routine requests about password resets, software access, common troubleshooting, and policy questions when the platform references approved knowledge.


Unthread's purpose-built AI agents reference internal knowledge and ticket context to achieve approximately[40% automatic resolution](https://unthread.io/blog/it-ticketing-software-msps/) while escalating complex requests to the appropriate technicians.


### **What should MSPs check before choosing a Teams ticketing platform?**


MSPs should review multi-tenant architecture, Teams integration depth, RMM/PSA compatibility,[billing automation](https://unthread.io/products/automations?ref=unthread.io) , AI capabilities, security compliance, and pricing transparency.


A tool may capture tickets, but MSPs also need to know whether it supports the full service delivery lifecycle.
